description: A generic header section that can have just a heading, but also a subheading and description.

agentGuidance.useWhen: A section heading: a heading with an optional subheading and one paragraph. Also opens a page that needs only a title and a sentence.
agentGuidance.avoidWhen: When the opener needs an image or a button (use Hero or BackgroundHero). This is not the site's navigation header.

alternatives.when: a headline with an image and a button

fields.name: Subheading
fields.label: Subheading
fields.description: Optional text that appears above the main heading. Used for category labels or eyebrow text.

fields.name: Heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: The main headline text. Should be compelling and descriptive.

fields.name: Description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Supporting text that provides additional context about the header content.
